skills.description: Project management and multi-agent work coordination through AuraBaba via the aura CLI. Use whenever a user asks to assign or delegate tasks (分配任务/派活), create or advance a project (创建项目/推进项目), split work across people or agents, track progress or blockers, add comments or labels, manage deliverables, set up scheduled automation or milestones (排期自动化/里程碑), or coordinate a team—even if they do not mention AuraBaba. Also onboard users who have not registered or do not have the aura CLI installed.
